author: Inside Edition
description: An unexpected diagnosis forced a veteran to redirect his life and its focus. Michael Collins is a member of The University of Texas at Arlington's wheelchair basketball team. Collins told CBS News he began playing the sport after serving in the Army. Before deploying to Afghanistan, a routine physical revealed a cancerous tumor in his leg. At age 26, doctors advised amputation to keep the cancer from spreading. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Veteran Finds New Purpose After Cancer Diagnosis Leads to Amputation
